race.comment: The maiden stayers close out the card. TRUST IN THE ROCK (5) was well in the betting here last time out but just ran into a couple better on that occasion. Drawn to get a gun run in transit from gate two and where there's smoke there's fire. Should be right there when the judge calls a halt. DURNESS (7) put in a career-best performance when runner-up here at the latest effort and should appreciate the extra journey. Sure to prove tough to hold out. FLIRTING WITH FIRE (8) has placed two of five here on her home circuit and will be rock-hard fit for this contest. In the mix. JOSEPHINE OF TUFFY (9) has placed at her past three efforts, draws low and gets some weight off with the claim. Plenty to like about her prospects. ACTS ALONE (1) rounds out the selections.
